name: Quest review stub (mechanics disabled)
description: While game mechanics are disabled (this change), a quest that enters in_review auto-advances to completed with a review-skipped verdict, emitting no XP or battle entities (spec: 'Mechanics side effects are stubbed in this change'). Purely phase-triggered — on_enter fires once on entering in_review and the transition to terminal completed prevents re-entry, so no command to clear. Phase 2 re-enables real review by replacing this one rule. Tracked as task 4.2.
